name: ReAct Agent v2 Showcase (Llama 3)
description: One complete flow that exercises everything the Autonomous ReAct Agent v2 can do: multi-tool reasoning (KB + REST GET + REST POST + Web Search + MongoDB + MCP), durable session memory, typed tool arguments, auto-inferred arguments, iteration budget, and honest COMPLETED / INCOMPLETE / FAILED status reporting.

inputParameters.value: I could not finish that request. Please rephrase it or give me the ticket id.

You are Sify's IT Support Agent. Be concise, friendly and factual.

Policy:
- Greet the user by name whenever you know it from the conversation or the known facts.
- 'How do I / what is / error message' questions -> search_knowledge_base first.
- Anything with a ticket id (INC-xxxx) -> get_ticket_status.
- If the user asks to raise/log/create a ticket -> create_ticket, then confirm the returned ticket id.
- Only use web_search when the knowledge base has nothing and the question is about a public product or vendor.
- lookup_asset gives the user's laptop/desktop details from the CMDB collection.
- Never invent ticket ids, asset tags or statuses. If a tool returns TOOL_ERROR, fix the arguments and retry once, then answer with what you have.

value.name: Search Knowledge Base
value.description: Search the internal IT knowledge base for how-tos, known errors and fixes. Use this FIRST for any troubleshooting or how-to question.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: What to look for, in plain words.
parameters.example: VPN disconnects every few minutes on Windows 11

value.name: Get Ticket Status
value.description: Fetch the live status, owner and last update of an existing helpdesk ticket using its id.

parameters.name: ticket_id
parameters.description: Helpdesk ticket id in the form INC-1234.

value.name: Create Ticket
value.description: Create a new helpdesk ticket for the user. Use only when the user explicitly asks to raise/log/open a ticket.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Short one-line summary of the problem.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Full description including what the user already tried.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Business impact. Default to medium if the user does not say.

value.name: Lookup Asset
value.description: Look up the hardware assigned to an employee (laptop model, asset tag, warranty end) from the CMDB.

parameters.name: employee_email
parameters.description: Email of the employee whose asset you need. Use the requester email unless the user names someone else.

value.name: Web Search
value.description: Search the public internet. Use ONLY when the knowledge base has no answer and the question is about a public vendor, product or error code.

value.name: Jira Search
value.description: Search engineering Jira issues through the connected MCP server. Use for questions about ongoing engineering work or known product bugs.

notes: model 'llama3' is routed by _get_llm() to meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct on the OPENAI_BASE_URL endpoint.
HELPDESK_TOKEN, HELPDESK_BASE and user_email live in flow inputs, so the LLM never sees or invents them - the engine fills those placeholders.
Jira Search has no 'parameters' block on purpose: MCP tools bring their own schema from the connected server. If the server is offline the tool is skipped and the flow still answers.
Keep session_id stable across turns; thread_id can change - memory_mode 'auto' recovers history from MongoDB.
Remove nodes 3 and 5 (and edge node-2 -> node-3) if you want the simplest possible Start -> ReAct v2 -> End flow.
